capabilities.description: Maintain comprehensive patient profiles including demographics, medical and dental history, contact details, and insurance information, with search and retrieval.
Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments across provider calendars, with conflict detection and status tracking.
Document treatment plans, procedures performed, clinical notes, and attachments linked to each patient's record.
Generate invoices for treatments, track payments, apply simple fee schedules, and maintain billing history per patient.
Identify patients due for recall visits and generate reminders based on configurable intervals, delivered via in-app notifications.
Manage staff accounts, assign roles (e.g., dentist, hygienist, admin), and enforce access permissions across modules.
Provide an at-a-glance dashboard of daily appointments, patient flow, outstanding invoices, and recall status.

summary: A staff-only back-office platform for a single dental clinic, covering patient records, appointment scheduling, treatment documentation, invoicing, recall reminders, staff roles and permissions, and an operational dashboard. It serves dentists, hygienists, and front-desk staff who need a simple, self-contained system with sensible defaults and no external integrations.
